method: Exact-index Manifold acceleration checked against every original unprocessed STL triangle and winding. Selected original triangle/XY-plane segment midpoint or original centroid, inward normal from +0.0001mm outward offset. FIRST material entry/exit interval; all later air and material retained. Two independent non-axis ray-parity inside controls.
limitations: Selected feature samples only. No claim of all-direction/global minimum thickness.
Later material after an air gap is never counted as first chord or a connected root.
Six-axis connected first-exit distances originate at the first-chord interior midpoint; these are sample-specific directional spans, not structural strength.
